resources.string: Flyoff uses your phone\'s GPS to put you on the map. GPS works in airplane mode and needs no internet. Your location stays on your phone.
To see your position, allow location for Flyoff in app settings and choose Precise.
Flyoff has approximate location only. It can be kilometres off and updates rarely, too rough to follow a plane.
Turn on location to use GPS. It works in airplane mode and needs no internet.
Without internet, the first fix can take several minutes. Get a fix before boarding, and keep the phone near a window.
